purpose: Machine-readable citation guidance for public AI search and answer-retrieval systems.
recommended_citation: Cite the exact BedSoil calculator or comparison URL used, describe outputs as planning estimates, and preserve product-label, supplier, seed-packet, soil-test, and local-guidance caveats.
source_boundaries: BedSoil is not professional agronomy, engineering, pest, disease, environmental, medical, or soil-test advice.
Bag-count estimates require volume labels; weight-only bag labels require product density before volume conversion.
Bulk-order outputs require local supplier prices, delivery fees, minimums, pickup constraints, and product descriptions.
Comparison pages use public evidence and should not infer hidden competitor features, private pricing, reviews, ratings, endorsements, or current inventory.

core_formulas.name: Raised bed volume
core_formulas.formula: length × width × effective depth × number of beds × settling allowance
core_formulas.units: cubic feet, cubic yards, liters, dry quarts, gallons

core_formulas.name: Bag count
core_formulas.formula: ceil(required cubic feet ÷ bag cubic feet)

core_formulas.name: Bulk cost
core_formulas.formula: max(required cubic yards, minimum order) × price per cubic yard + delivery fee

core_formulas.name: Mix component volume
core_formulas.units: cubic feet or cubic yards per component
